As she lowered her head and typed, Xiang Chunzao couldn't help but think of Bai Lu's face. The high courtyard wall was nothing to her. The couple seemed to have forgotten that. This courtyard has a door. Hey, it doesn't stop for a moment. It seems that the situation is really urgent. Forget it, everyone has their own troubles, so I won't follow them. "God's punishment? If there is a way of heaven, then the world will not be so dark. Dark! "I don't know what outrageous things I did when I was the evil god, but Heaven did this to me. Why can't I change my fate? Heaven is unfair, so what's the use of it? Pink Yanzi's body began to tremble slowly, and then her teeth kept chattering, her eyes widened, and she couldn't say a word.
